-- ================================================================
-- SIGMA SHADERS
-- ================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Safely remove any old versions of the GUI
if playerGui:FindFirstChild("SigmaShadersGui") then
    playerGui.SigmaShadersGui:Destroy()
end

-- Global RGB Color Cycle for UI accents
local currentRGB = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local hue = (tick() * 0.15) % 1
    currentRGB = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
end)

-- Shader Toggles State Table (All Shaders Available to Combine)
local shaderStates = {
    Bloom = false,
    ColorGrade = false,
    DepthField = false,
    SunRays = false,
    UltraShine = false
}

-- Effect Object Holders
local activeEffects = {
    Bloom = nil,
    ColorGrade = nil,
    DepthField = nil,
    SunRays = nil
}

-- Shader Engine Manager (Allows stacking multiple shaders together)
local function refreshShaderEngine()
    -- 1. Cinematic Bloom Effect
    if shaderStates.Bloom then
        if not activeEffects.Bloom then
            local b = Instance.new("BloomEffect", Lighting)
            b.Intensity = 0.85
            b.Size = 35
            b.Threshold = 0.45
            activeEffects.Bloom = b
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.Bloom then activeEffects.Bloom:Destroy(); activeEffects.Bloom = nil end
    end

    -- 2. Vibrant Color Grade Effect
    if shaderStates.ColorGrade then
        if not activeEffects.ColorGrade then
            local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
            cc.Brightness = 0.04
            cc.Contrast = 0.4
            cc.Saturation = 0.35
            cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(245, 238, 255)
            activeEffects.ColorGrade = cc
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.ColorGrade then activeEffects.ColorGrade:Destroy(); activeEffects.ColorGrade = nil end
    end

    -- 3. Focal Depth Blur Effect
    if shaderStates.DepthField then
        if not activeEffects.DepthField then
            local dof = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect", Lighting)
            dof.FarIntensity = 0.4
            dof.FocusDistance = 20
            dof.InFocusRadius = 22
            activeEffects.DepthField = dof
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.DepthField then activeEffects.DepthField:Destroy(); activeEffects.DepthField = nil end
    end

    -- 4. Atmospheric Sun Rays Effect
    if shaderStates.SunRays then
        if not activeEffects.SunRays then
            local sr = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect", Lighting)
            sr.Intensity = 0.5
            sr.Spread = 1
            activeEffects.SunRays = sr
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.SunRays then activeEffects.SunRays:Destroy(); activeEffects.SunRays = nil end
    end

    -- 5. 10x Ultra Shine (Mirror World)
    if shaderStates.UltraShine then
        Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Future
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 10
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 2
        Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.1

        pcall(function()
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj.Anchored and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    -- Skip dynamic/character parts safely
                elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if obj.Material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or obj.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic or obj.Material == Enum.Material.Wood then
                        obj.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
                        obj.Reflectance = 1.0
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.5
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.5
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- BUILD USER INTERFACE
-- ==========================================
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "SigmaShadersGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.DisplayOrder = 9999
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 390)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -195)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local frameStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
frameStroke.Thickness = 2.5
frameStroke.Parent = mainFrame

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if frameStroke and frameStroke.Parent then
        frameStroke.Color = currentRGB
    end
end)

-- Title Bar (Drag Handle)
local titleBar = Instance.new("TextButton")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 20)
titleBar.AutoButtonColor = false
titleBar.Text = "   ⚡ SIGMA SHADERS HUB"
titleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleBar.TextSize = 16
titleBar.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleBar.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

-- Minimize Button (-)
local minButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
minButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
minButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 7)
minButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 34)
minButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
minButton.TextSize = 18
minButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minButton.Text = "-"
minButton.Parent = titleBar

local minCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
minCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
minCorner.Parent = minButton

-- Content Container
local container = Instance.new("Frame")
container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -50)
container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
container.Parent = mainFrame

-- Shader Buttons Configuration (All 5 Combined)
local shaderButtons = {
    {Key = "Bloom", Label = "✨ Cinematic Bloom"},
    {Key = "ColorGrade", Label = "🎨 Vibrant Color Grade"},
    {Key = "DepthField", Label = "📷 Focal Depth Blur"},
    {Key = "SunRays", Label = "☀️ Atmospheric Sun Rays"},
    {Key = "UltraShine", Label = "💎 10x Ultra Shine (Mirror World)"}
}

for i, shader in ipairs(shaderButtons) do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 328, 0, 46)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 12 + (i - 1) * 54)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 240)
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Text = shader.Label .. "  [ OFF ]"
    btn.Parent = container

    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    btnCorner.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        shaderStates[shader.Key] = not shaderStates[shader.Key]
        refreshShaderEngine()

        if shaderStates[shader.Key] then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 185, 90)
            btn.Text = shader.Label .. "  [ ACTIVE ]"
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
            btn.Text = shader.Label .. "  [ OFF ]"
        end
    end)
end

-- Minimize / Maximize Toggle Logic
local minimized = false
minButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    if minimized then
        minButton.Text = "+"
        mainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 50), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
        container.Visible = false
    else
        minButton.Text = "-"
        mainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 390), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
        task.wait(0.1)
        container.Visible = true
    end
end)

-- Smooth Mobile & PC Window Dragging Logic
local draggingWindow = false
local dragStart, startPos

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        draggingWindow = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                draggingWindow = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if draggingWindow and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        draggingWindow = false
    end
end)

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

    end

    if not estado then
        stopFly()
        return

    if flying then return end

    local character = LP.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            return

        if not camera then return end

        local move = humanoid.MoveDirection

        local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector

        local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        local flatRight = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)

        if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
            flatLook = flatLook.Unit
        end

        if flatRight.Magnitude > 0 then
            flatRight = flatRight.Unit
        end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            direction = look * move:Dot(flatLook)
                + right * move:Dot(flatRight)
        end

        if not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                direction += look
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                direction -= look
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                direction -= right
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                direction += right
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
                direction += Vector3.yAxis
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                direction -= Vector3.yAxis
            end
        end

        bv.Velocity = direction.Magnitude > 0
            and direction.Unit * FLY_SPEED
            or Vector3.zero

        bg.CFrame = camera.CFrame
    end)

-- Ultra Instinct: Player + Unanchored Part Dodge
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- Use a LocalScript

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local DODGE_DISTANCE = 5
local PART_DODGE_DISTANCE = 3

local TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MIN = 3
local TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MAX = 5

local DODGE_COOLDOWN = 0.35
local lastDodge = 0

local function findNearbyThreat(myRoot)
    -- Check nearby players
    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= player then
            local character = otherPlayer.Character
            local root = character
                and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = character
                and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    <= DODGE_DISTANCE then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Check nearby unanchored parts
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
        myRoot.Position,
        PART_DODGE_DISTANCE
    )) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart")
            and not part.Anchored
            and not part:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then

            -- Ignore parts belonging to player characters
            local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            local isCharacter = model
                and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)

            if not isCharacter then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function randomDodge(character, myRoot)
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random(
        TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MIN,
        TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MAX
    )

    local offset = Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )

    local destination = myRoot.Position + offset

    -- Find the ground at the destination
    local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}

    local result = workspace:Raycast(
        destination + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0),
        Vector3.new(0, -40, 0),
        rayParams
    )

    if result then
        destination = Vector3.new(
            destination.X,
            result.Position.Y + 3,
            destination.Z
        )
    else
        destination = Vector3.new(
            destination.X,
            myRoot.Position.Y,
            destination.Z
        )
    end

    character:PivotTo(
        CFrame.new(destination) * myRoot.CFrame.Rotation
    )
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if os.clock() - lastDodge < DODGE_COOLDOWN then
        return
    end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local myRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not myRoot or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    if findNearbyThreat(myRoot) then
        lastDodge = os.clock()
        randomDodge(character, myRoot)
    end
end)

local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local ts = game:GetService("TweenService")
local logs = game:GetService("LogService")

local setclip = setclipboard or toclipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set)

local function getLogs(console)
    local lines = {}
    local scroller = console:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame", true)
    
    if scroller then
        for _, v in ipairs(scroller:GetDescendants()) do
            if (v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextBox")) and v.Text ~= "" then
                table.insert(lines, {
                    order = v.LayoutOrder,
                    y = v.AbsolutePosition.Y,
                    text = v.Text
                })
            end
        end
    end

    if #lines > 0 then
        table.sort(lines, function(a, b)
            if a.order ~= 0 and b.order ~= 0 and a.order ~= b.order then
                return a.order < b.order
            end
            return a.y < b.y
        end)
        local res = {}
        for i = 1, #lines do
            res[i] = lines[i].text
        end
        return table.concat(res, "\n")
    end

    local history = logs:GetLogHistory()
    local raw = {}
    for i, item in ipairs(history) do
        raw[i] = item.message
    end
    return table.concat(raw, "\n")
end

local function checkValid(btn)
    if not (btn and btn:IsA("GuiObject") and btn.Name == "Clear") then return false end
    local buttons = btn.Parent
    if not (buttons and buttons.Name == "Buttons") then return false end
    local rConsole = buttons.Parent
    if not (rConsole and rConsole.Name == "RobloxConsole") then return false end
    local console = rConsole.Parent
    return (console and console.Name == "Console")
end

local function init()
    for _, obj in ipairs(cg:GetDescendants()) do
        if checkValid(obj) then
            local buttons = obj.Parent
            local rConsole = buttons.Parent
            
            if not buttons:FindFirstChild("Copy") then
                local copy = obj:Clone()
                copy.Name = "Copy"
                
                local title = copy:FindFirstChild("Title")
                if title then title.Text = "Copy" end
                
                local layout = buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
                if layout then
                    copy.LayoutOrder = obj.LayoutOrder + 1

                    local w = obj.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and (obj.AbsoluteSize.X + 8) or 65
                    copy.Position = UDim2.new(obj.Position.X.Scale, obj.Position.X.Offset + w, obj.Position.Y.Scale, obj.Position.Y.Offset)
                end
                
                local defaultColor = copy.BackgroundColor3
                local busy = false
                
                local tIn = ts:Create(copy, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 175, 85)
                })
                local tOut = ts:Create(copy, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = defaultColor
                })
                
                local function handleClick()
                    if busy then return end
                    busy = true
                    
                    if setclip then
                        setclip(getLogs(rConsole))

                    if title then title.Text = "Copied!" end

                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

                    end
                end)
                
                copy.Parent = buttons

        end
    end

ExecuteBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local code = ScriptBox.Text
    
    if string.match(code, "https?://") and not string.match(code, "\n") then
        local success, res = pcall(function()
            return game:HttpGet(code)
        end)
        if success and res then
            code = res
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Info]: Successfully fetched script from URL!"
        else
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Error]: Failed to fetch URL content!"
            return
        end
    end

    local func, syntaxErr = loadstring(code)
    if func then
        local success, err = pcall(func)
        if success then
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Success]: Script executed successfully without errors."
        else
            ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
            ConsoleBox.Text = "[Runtime Error]: " .. tostring(err)
        end
    else
        ConsoleBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
        ConsoleBox.Text = "[Syntax Error]: " .. tostring(syntaxErr)
    end
end)

    for _, obj in ipairs(LocalPlayer:GetDescendants()) do

local function getTargetPlayerName()
    local text = TargetInput.Text
    if text == "" or string.lower(text) == "all" then
        return "all"
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.sub(string.lower(p.Name), 1, string.len(text)) == string.lower(text) then
            return p.Name
        end
    end
    return text

local function executeHDCommand(cmdFormat, extraArg)
    local target = getTargetPlayerName()
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local success, requestCommand = pcall(function()
        return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient").Signals.RequestCommandSilent
    end)
    if success and requestCommand then
        pcall(function()
            local fullCmd
            if extraArg then
                fullCmd = string.format(cmdFormat, target, extraArg)
            else
                fullCmd = string.format(cmdFormat, target)
            end
            requestCommand:InvokeServer(fullCmd)
        end)
    end
end
